_comment: Workday boards. Separate from ats_boards.json because a Workday board needs host/tenant/site rather than a single slug, and because this source runs on its own slower timer -- every posting costs a detail request, so it cannot ride the 6-hourly pass. See AGENTS.md.
_verified: All entries confirmed live 2026-10-24 by POSTing {tenant}/{site}/jobs and reading `total`; Logitech added 2026-11-15, confirmed the same way (200, total 220, site slug `Logitech` -- `External` 404s on that tenant). A wrong site slug returns 422 and a wrong tenant still returns 406 from the wildcard host, so a board MUST be confirmed by a 200 with a total -- do not add one on a guess. The two Trend Micro rows were added 2026-11-15, confirmed the same way (External total 180, External_TrendLife total 19) against a `zzznotacompany99` control that returned 422.
_missing: AMD, Qualcomm, Lam Research, Dell and Analog Devices have Workday tenants but none of the site slugs tried worked. TSMC and MediaTek are NOT on Workday: TSMC 403s all automation including its own robots.txt, and MediaTek runs a bespoke Strapi site with no public API. Re-probed 2026-11-15 on request: TSMC is still 403 on careers.tsmc.com, www.tsmc.com/english/careers and its robots.txt, and tsmc.wd1/wd3/wd5 all answer 422 -- the same status the nonsense control tenant returns, so it is no evidence of a tenant. Synology is not on Workday either (422, same as the control), but unlike TSMC it IS reachable: career.synology.com/api is a keyless JSON API whose list call carries descriptions inline, and its robots.txt allows everything. It needs a fifth provider module, not a row in this file.
